title: Understanding Recall
text: Recall is the ratio of true positive predictions to the total actual positives. It measures how many of the actual positive cases were correctly predicted.

title: Calculating Accuracy
text: Accuracy is the ratio of correctly predicted instances to the total instances. To maintain accuracy above $$0.75$$, calculate the number of correct predictions needed.

title: Threshold and Predictions
text: The threshold determines whether a predicted probability is classified as $$1$$ or $$0$$. Adjust the threshold to maximize recall while maintaining accuracy.

title: Calculate True Positives
text: Identify the true positive cases based on the threshold. Which predicted probabilities should be classified as $$1$$ to maximize recall?

title: Calculate Accuracy
text: Determine the number of correct predictions needed to maintain accuracy above $$0.75$$. How many predictions must be correct out of 5?
